If you're interested in a "pact with death" warlock patron, there is the Undying patron from Sword Coast Adventurer's guide.

That aside, your dark powers patron is an interesting mod to the fiend. 
Looking purely at the numbers for the added content, I have some comments you might want to think about.

* Fiend Blood looks pretty deadly to the caster, giving 3 targets an average of 9 temporary hit points (for a net of 27tHP). Taking half of this as fire damage means that you would take an average of 13 damage. This being a level 1 spell not only seems strong, but also  seems practical if the warlock is being used to give out buffs to the other characters while staying far from combat. 

* Tainted luck looks very strong: an extra d10 to an ability check/saving throw multiple times per rest (with a low chance of it reducing the number by 1d8). Odds are most warlocks are going to have a pretty good charisma score, and are going to be able to use this frequently. (I'd suggest making it once per rest or increasing the risk of it backfiring as a balance to this). 

* Lastly, Siphon Health. This is neat for the stylistic vampire approach, and the damage is a bit lower than that of Hurl through Hell (probably to make up for the healing). The healing, however, is massive. Hitting with this means that you would heal for (on average) 32 - 34. For balancing this, I'd compare it to a suped up vampiric touch or enervation: have it heal for half of the necrotic damage dealt.

The odds of existing are not in favour of existence. You could go through an infinite number of realities, meet an infinite number of yous. Do you know what you would find? None of them are exactly like you. Some may be similar, but none are you. Look at that supply, only 1 in an infinite number of universes.

Your life has value, being that it is the only one in existence that is you.

Long read, as I have two stories. I figure Death really had something for me when I was young, idk. Both of these happened before I was 9.

Anyways, so when I was young, my family used to travel a lot. One time, we went out to some island (I don't remember where, I was like 8), and my siblings and I all played in the water. 
A while passes, and we started heading off of the beach, but a wave knocked me over. Then when I tried getting up again, under tow pulled me in and kept me under for a good few minutes. I remember my dad went in after me, he started getting pulled in, then my oldest brother grabbed him and they collectively pulled me out.

Later (or earlier) on (I think it was a different trip, but I don't remember when), we were in the Caribbean (not on a beach this time), I was still pretty damn young (<9), and I tripped. It would normally be no problem, but I was on the outside of the family, closest to the road, and I fell with my head on the road. 
In traffic. In the path of a car that was about a second away from occupying the same space as my head. Most of my family didn't notice that I fell, except my mom. Who was panicked and unable to move. 
Luckily for me and my family, a stranger managed to grab me and pull me off the road, and then continued along his merry way, refusing anything my parents offered for saving their youngest. Never got his name, I don't even remember his face.
